{{Top|leg}}
A '''servo driver''' was a component that could be added to [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]]s through a modification kit. The servo driver system allowed the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] underslung [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to depress up to ninety degrees. With the weapons able to be orientated in this way, the A-9 was capable of performing strafing missions against ground forces.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
